<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Jio Platforms IPO:</strong> SEBI has approved the ₹37,000 crore initial public offering for Jio Platforms, positioning it to become the largest IPO in Indian market history.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTFB5MW55V0p3Rmdic0JSTnhIbjAwUTY4dmNlV2dYXzhaQ2JrVE1vSndLNXJibGdGVEpvUGIzcllacEdaeFNwbklQTWZrWFRvTDJBbUJRVzNkLXB4ajVacWp4RkoyeDNGaDNjOWc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Forex Reserves:</strong> India&#x27;s foreign exchange reserves have reached an all-time high of $729.3 billion, reflecting robust external liquidity buffers.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory Updates:</strong> SEBI has introduced a comprehensive set of regulatory changes impacting market intermediaries, foreign investors, and alternative investment funds to enhance governance norms.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>IT Sector Rally:</strong> Indian markets saw a 331-point gain in the Sensex as IT stocks rebounded, bolstered by strong earnings outlooks and positive sentiment surrounding Nvidia.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxOYTJIZm9fLXRpNUZSUWVCX1FPZXVmVHNZSmJwX0ZscFI0dkkxc2xtc3JtVHpkMk9ZUmtXX2RPZjU3ZlZPcTQybFdJQWpFakUtZHljN0FOakhCMGVheFpuMGFxVDdfejdQck41ZnREV0pVNl9nLWtUeDE4RXVfZlI0UkJ2dnYtUVkzbV9HYkl0dFhTS2VL?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Economic Outlook:</strong> Analysts expect upcoming GDP data to demonstrate continued resilience in the Indian economy, providing a supportive backdrop for the rupee.</li>
</ul>
